phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Triple Quadrupole Liquid Chromatography–Mass Spectrometry (LC–MS) system incorporating a triple quadrupole mass analyzer for targeted quantitative analysis. This system integrates liquid chromatography for sample separation with a triple quadrupole mass spectrometer for highly sensitive and selective detection and quantification of analytes.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: Triple Quadrupole LC–MS instruments are the industry standard for quantitative bioanalysis in pharmaceutical and life sciences research due to their capability for multiple reaction monitoring (MRM), high sensitivity, and specificity. They are widely adopted for drug metabolism, pharmacokinetics, environmental analysis, and clinical diagnostics, distinguishing them from single quadrupole or high-resolution MS technologies.
